description: Declares event flags by name: a flag is one yes/no fact of the story that the save keeps ("this pickup was taken", "this door is open", "this cutscene was seen"). Scripts test and set them with sh.flag_get / sh.flag_set, map data (events, world objects, spawn rules, the paper map) names them the same way, and a save stores the names of the flags that are set. Each entry: "description" says what sets the flag and what it changes; "aliases" are former names that still resolve everywhere (old saves, scripts and mods); "old_save_names" are former names that now name another flag, so they are read only from saves written before the rename. The engine gives every flag its save bit itself (the original layout of the base flags is the "event_flags" list of original_order.json). A mod adds its own flags with a flags.json or flags/*.json of the same shape in its folder (names are then <mod folder>:Name). Event flags of map1, Midwich Elementary School: the fog school 1F, 2F, courtyard and basement (map1_s00, map1_s01), its Otherworld version (map1_s02, map1_s03), the Split Head fight (map1_s05) and the school after the boss (map1_s06): doors, keys, the clock tower and medallion puzzles, cutscenes, pickups.

M1S00_GoldMedallionPlaced.description: Set when the Gold Medallion is inserted into the 'golden sun' receptacle of the clock tower. Changes the clock picture/message (hands at 12:00); with the silver one it opens the clock tower puzzle and the piano puzzle.

M1S00_SilverMedallionPlaced.description: Set when the Silver Medallion is inserted into the 'silver moon' receptacle of the clock tower. Changes the clock (5:00), enables the boiler switch and the clock tower hum.

M1S00_BoilerRunning.description: Set during the boiler scene once the boiler is running (after the light pulses and the distant vocal). Shows 'the boiler is working' afterwards and lets the clock tower room load.

M1S01_HandStatueMelted.description: Set when the Chemical is used on the hand statue (smoke scene). The statue melts and the Gold Medallion can be taken.

M1S01_PianoPuzzleSolved.description: Set when the piano puzzle in the music room of the school, 2F (map1_s01, event 7, available after the gold medallion is placed) is played correctly and the silver medallion falls out. It enables the silver medallion pickup, places the medallion on the floor, and makes later piano checks only show a message.

M1S01_LockerCatJumpedOut.description: Set when the cat bursts out of the rattling locker on 2F (and again at the scene's end). Stops the locker rattle.

M1S01_LockerCatSceneDone.description: Set at the end of the locker cat scene. The locker door rests ajar, its inspect message is enabled and more Grey Children spawn on 2F.

M1S00_EastHatchDropRoomLoaded.description: Transient: set when the basement room has loaded after going down at map point 19 (-100, -60.8); triggers the drop-down scene, which lands Harry at (-60, -63.7) and clears it.

M1S00_EastHatchClimbStarted.description: Transient: set when Harry climbs up from the basement at map point 16 (-60, -64); loads the room back at point 19. Cleared at the next climb.

M1S00_WestHatchClimbStarted.description: Transient: set when Harry climbs up from the basement at map point 17 (-60, -56); loads the room back at point 21. Cleared at the next climb.

M1S00_WestHatchDropRoomLoaded.description: Transient: set when the basement room has loaded after going down at map point 21 (-140, -59.2); the drop-down scene lands Harry at (-60, -56.3) facing 180 and clears it.

M1S00_HatchClimbRoomLoaded.description: Transient: set when the room load of a basement climb (either spot) has run; blocks the second load. Cleared at the start of every climb.

M1S00_BoilerSwitchPressed.description: Set when Harry answers yes to 'press the switch?' at the boiler: the hum starts and the clock tower hum begins to swell.

M1S00_BoilerSceneDone.description: Set at the end of the boiler scene; the clock tower hum stays at full volume and is heard from the far side too.

M1S02_CourtyardIntroStarted.description: Set when the arrival scene of the Otherworld school courtyard starts ('Where am I?', 'Have I been here before?').

M1S02_CourtyardIntroWalkStarted.description: Cleared at the start of the courtyard arrival scene and set when Harry starts walking after 'Have I been here before?'. Nothing in the game reads it.

M1S02_PickupPictureCard.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the picture card on map1_s02 (School Otherworld - 1F and courtyard) at map point 29 (x 139.0, z 99.3 m), event 28; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M1S02_SeenDoorWithHorizontalSlot.description: Set in the Otherworld school, 1F (map1_s02) after Harry inspects the reception plaques (RECEPDR1 picture) and notices the horizontal slot in the centre. Later inspections show a different message ("If I push it, it moves a bit." instead of "What? Is this a door?").

M1S02_PickupShotgun.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the shotgun on map1_s02 (School Otherworld - 1F and courtyard) at map point 35 (x 17.9, z 59.5 m) (also map2_s04), event 23; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M1S02_BathroomDoorPushedOpen.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry pushes the bathroom door that blocks the corpse holding the shotgun. The door stays open (no collision) and the Shotgun can be taken.

M1S02_MonsterLurksMessageRead.description: Set when Harry reads the 'Leonard Rhine - The Monster Lurks' message (picture LVTRYMSG.TIM) on 1F. Makes 'The Monster Lurks' book in the 2F library readable.

M1S02_PhoneCallDone.description: Set at the end of the phone call scene by the clock (Cheryl's voice). Creepers start to spawn on 1F and the room music returns.

M1S02_PhoneReceiverInHand.description: Set while Harry holds the phone receiver during the phone call (the receiver models on the table are hidden); cleared when he puts it down and at the scene's end.

M1S03_LockerInspectStarted.description: Set when Harry first inspects the locker of the Otherworld locker room. Changes the room camera and holds the music of room 38 until the dead-body scene is over.

M1S03_LockerDoorPulled.description: Set when Harry starts pulling the locker door (first animation of the inspect scene, or on skip).

M1S03_LockerDoorOpened.description: Set at the second animation of the locker inspect scene (or on skip): with M1S03_LockerDoorPulled the locker door is drawn open and its contents shown.

M1S03_LockerOpened.description: Set when Harry pulls open the locker in the locker room of the Otherworld school, 2F (map1_s03). It enables the dead-body scene at the open locker (event 91), changes what inspecting the locker does, and keeps the locker door drawn open.

M1S03_LockerInspectDone.description: Set at the end of the locker inspect scene ('Nothing inside.'): the locker door snaps open and the locker camera is held until the dead-body scene.

M1S03_LockerBodySceneStarted.description: Set when the dead-body scene of the Otherworld locker starts (the side locker swings open and the body falls out). Shows the second locker's contents and starts the body.

M1S03_LockerBodyFellOut.description: Set when the swinging side-locker door has come to rest; the dead body lies on the floor. Enables the Library Reserve Key pickup and the 'dead body' messages.

M1S03_LockerBodySceneDone.description: Set at the end of the dead-body scene. Shows the Library Reserve Key model, releases the locker camera and the room music.

M1S03_PickupLibraryReserveKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the library reserve key on map1_s03 (School Otherworld - 2F and roof) at map point 82 (x -60.3, z 20.2 m), event 94; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M1S02_PickupRubberBall.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the rubber ball on map1_s02 (School Otherworld - 1F and courtyard) at map point 33 (x 100.2, z 100.9 m), event 24; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M1S02_UsedRubberBall.description: Set when the rubber ball is used on the drain pipe on the Otherworld school roof (map1_s03, events 21/22). With it set, opening the roof drainage valve sends the water down the right pipe and washes the classroom key down the drain; without it Harry says it drains into the wrong hole.

M1S03_KeyInDrainSeen.description: Set when Harry looks into the courtyard drain and sees the key down there (picture HOLEKEY0.TIM). Lets the roof drain valve wash the key down (M1S03_KeyDownTheDrain).

M1S03_KeyDownTheDrain.description: Set when the roof drainage valve in the Otherworld school (map1_s03) is opened after the rubber ball was used, so the water carries the classroom key down to the courtyard drain. It enables the classroom key pickup at the drain (map1_s02 and map1_s03) and changes the drain's picture to the one with the key.

M1S02_PickupClassroomKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the classroom key on map1_s02 (School Otherworld - 1F and courtyard) at map point 103 (x -16.2, z -51.6 m) (also map1_s03), event 13; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M1S03_MonsterLurksBookRead.description: Set after Harry first reads "The Monster Lurks" book on the library floor of the Otherworld school (map1_s03). Later reads skip the longer first-time scene.

M1S03_LibraryFairyTaleRead.description: Set after the first full read of the old fairy tale on the library counter (the hunter's tale, hint on how to beat Split Head); later reads skip the closing line.

M1S02_BossGateTurnedFromSouth.description: Transient: set while the rotating gate is turned from the panel at map point 40 (60.5, -61.1); picks the turning direction and sound position. Cleared at the end of the scene.

M1S02_BossGateTurnedFromNorth.description: Transient: set while the rotating gate is turned from the panel at map point 39 (60.5, -58.9). Cleared at the end of the scene.

M1S02_BossLiftRidden.description: Set when the lift platform at (54.2, -60) has finished going down; the next tick loads the Split Head boss room (map1_s05).

M1S02_BathroomDoorSceneStarted.description: Set when the bathroom door scene starts (voice line 56); while set the music of room 5 is cut down (fuller once the door is open). Cleared when Harry enters room 11.

M1S02_PhoneCallStarted.description: Set when the phone call scene starts (the phone rings, voice line 53). Until the call is done the music of room 7 is cut to layer 1.

M1S05_BossLampFlickering.description: Set after the corridor light flash at the start of the Split Head room; while set the burning lamp's light flickers. Cleared when Split Head is defeated.

M1S05_SplitHeadIntroDone.description: Set at the end of the Split Head room intro (light flash). Split Head starts to act, the lamp starts in its burnt state on reload.

M1S05_SplitHeadKilled.description: Set by Split Head's death animation. Starts the defeat scene; also switches the street monsters near the church and the broken windows of map0_s02.

M1S05_SplitHeadDefeatSceneDone.description: Set at the end of Split Head's defeat scene (light swells and fades); the next tick loads the school after the boss (map1_s06).

M1S06_AfterBossFmvSeen.description: Set after the FMV that plays on arrival in the school after Split Head (file XA/M4_02490). Switches the school music to its full layers and the Old Town streets to their later ambience.

M1S06_WokeUpAfterBoss.description: Set at the end of the wake-up scene in the school basement after Split Head ('Where am I?'). Ends the dark-town effects of Old Town, enables the school front door from the street, and Groaners in town move faster.

M1S06_LeftBasement.description: Set when Harry takes the basement stairs (map point 38, (60, -19)) up after the boss; triggers the church bell scene that marks the church on the map.

M1S06_ChurchMarkedOnMap.description: Set at the end of the church bell scene that plays once Harry leaves the school basement after the boss (map1_s06, event 44). The scene marks the church on the Old Silent Hill map (MapMark_OldTown_BalkanChurchCircle) and the flag keeps it from replaying.

M1S06_PickupKGordonKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the kgordon key on map1_s06 (School - 1F and basement after the boss) at map point 10 (x 20.9, z -17.3 m), event 3; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M1S06_CorridorDoorFoundUnlocked.description: Set when Harry first tries the door at map point 22 (106.6, 49.1) after the boss and gets 'It's unlocked.'; marks its arrows on the 1F map (MapMark_FogSchool1F_BotRightCorridorArrows) and makes it a normal door.

M1S06_LobbyDoorFoundUnlocked.description: Set when Harry first tries the door at map point 14 (140, 18.4) after the boss and gets 'It's unlocked.'; marks the lobby arrows on the 1F map and makes it a normal door.

M1S06_FrontDoorWestFoundUnlocked.description: School front door, leaf at map point 1 (99.1, 16.4) inside / point 46 on the street: set on the first try after the boss ('It's unlocked.' inside); afterwards the door leads between the school and Old Town.

M1S06_FrontDoorEastFoundUnlocked.description: School front door, leaf at map point 2 (100.9, 16.4) inside / point 45 on the street: set on the first try after the boss; afterwards the door leads between the school and Old Town.

M1S06_EntranceHallReached.description: Set when Harry reaches the cell of the school entrance (x 80..120, z 0..40) after the boss; the basement hum fades out and does not restart. Also turns the school circle on the town map into a check mark.

M1S06_BasementHumStarted.description: Set during the wake-up scene in the basement (or on skip): the basement hum starts and keeps playing until Harry reaches the entrance hall.
